originating_goal: Treat every applicable federal security requirement as a minimum and require StegVerse HIL controls to exceed that floor.
claim_expiration_or_release_condition: Release chat ownership after the policy, profile, schema, validator, workflow, task record, and canonical handoff are committed; repository-native owners retain control-evidence execution.
collision_boundaries: Site owns the policy and sanitized evidence admission only
TVC owns runtime and protected-value controls
master-records/orchestration owns custody and reconstruction evidence
no repository may infer certification or activation from this policy alone
expected_evidence: owner-specific evidence for every required control
security activation state PASS only after all required controls are IMPLEMENTED
machine_observable_release_condition: data/hil-federal-plus-security-baseline.json activation.state becomes PASS and the hosted validator receipt has validation_state PASS with zero nonimplemented required controls.
next_executable_action: Run the hosted validator and assign each non-IMPLEMENTED control to the repository owner named in the profile.
